fix(purgecss): remove at-rules left empty after purging (#964) (#1537)

An at-rule was only removed when its direct child was purged and it had
no child nodes left. A @media containing a comment, or containing an
at-rule that was itself just removed (e.g. @supports inside @media), was
left in the output as an empty block.

Treat rules and at-rules that only contain comments as empty, and keep
removing the parents left empty up to (but not including) the root.
PurgeCSS ignore annotations are not treated as removable comments, so
they are still processed.
